title: The Reserve Held in Store for Conditioning Still Owed on a Lot
content:
Bushels are held back for the conditioning still owed, because water yet to come off the lot cannot be hauled home. This rule governs releases out of store under Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements.

## The test applied

Where the conditioning charges standing on the account show points no shrink line covers and the agreement carries bushels pledged against an outstanding warehouse receipt, the wide conditioning reserve of 800 bushels stays in store.

Where the conditioning charges show points no shrink line covers and the agreement carries no bushels pledged against an outstanding warehouse receipt, the light conditioning reserve of 250 bushels stays in store.

And otherwise, every point the conditioning charges show being covered by a shrink line, nothing is held back for conditioning.

## What counts as a point no shrink line covers

The points not yet covered are the points the conditioning charges standing on the account show, less the points the shrink lines on it carry, taken to no less than nothing and carried to one decimal place. Where that figure stands above nothing, points stand uncovered.

## Condition and result

| Points the conditioning charges show that no shrink line covers | Bushels pledged against an outstanding warehouse receipt | Held back in store |
| --- | --- | --- |
| more than nil | some | 800 |
| more than nil | none | 250 |
| nil | either way | nothing |

## Worked reserves, on hypothetical accounts

**Conditioning charges totalling 4.0 points, shrink lines carrying 2.5 points, and 3000 bushels pledged against an outstanding receipt.** One and a half points stand uncovered, and bushels stand pledged, so 800 bushels stay in store.

**The same points with nothing pledged on the agreement.** One and a half points stand uncovered and nothing is pledged, so 250 bushels stay in store.

**Conditioning charges totalling 4.0 points and shrink lines carrying 4.0 points.** No point stands uncovered, so nothing is held back for conditioning.
